accessionNo.sh: The filing's accession number for reported rows; null for estimates

aggregateMarketValue.sh: Aggregate market value of the shares to be sold, USD

amendmentNo.sh: Amendment number; null for the original filing

amountUsd.sh: Dollars obligated by this action; negative for de-obligations

asOf.sh: Balance sheet date of the figures

awardType.sh: Definitive contract, delivery order, BPA call, purchase order

basis.sh: Reference date for an estimated row; null for reported rows

buybacks.sh: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock for the fiscal year, USD

buyers.sh: Up to five buyers, largest first

capPct.sh: Maximum return as % of initial level when the note is capped

changePct.sh: Change in short quantity vs the prior report

company.sh: Filer name as on the filing

coupon.sh: Annual coupon %; null on preliminary filings, which are filed before the rate is set

date.sh: The reported date (filing date of the 8-K) or the estimated date

dateOfFirstSale.sh: ISO date; null when the first sale has yet to occur

description.sh: Security description as the SEC publishes it

docUrl.sh: Link to the filing index on sec.gov

entityType.sh: Corporation, Limited Partnership, LLC, Trust and so on

eventDate.sh: Date of the event that requires the filing

fairValueUsd.sh: Fair value of crypto assets as filed, USD

firstRegistration.sh: Earliest S-1 or F-1 on file for the filer; a 424B4 weeks after it is an IPO pricing

formType.sh: S-1, S-1/A, F-1, F-1/A, 424B4, RW or EFFECT

fundType.sh: Hedge, Private Equity, Venture Capital or Other Investment Fund, funds only

impliedPrice.sh: fairValueUsd divided by units, the filing's own valuation per coin

industryGroup.sh: SEC industry category (Pooled Investment Fund for funds)

insiderTitle.sh: Role at the company (CEO, CFO, Director...)

insiders.sh: Distinct insiders who bought on the open market in the window

issuer.sh: Filing entity (BofA Finance, Morgan Stanley Finance...)

latestFiledAt.sh: When the latest of those filings reached EDGAR

listed.sh: Filer is on the SEC's listed-ticker table today; a company that has priced is listed by now

meta.sh: Who publishes the data and how to credit it

minimumInvestment.sh: USD minimum accepted from an outside investor

mod.sh: Modification number; 0 or null is the original award

netIncome.sh: Net income for the same fiscal year, USD

offeringAmount.sh: Always null; offering amounts are not included

personName.sh: Person for whose account the shares are to be sold

personType.sh: Type of reporting person as filed, e.g.

price.sh: Closing price the SEC reports with the row, USD

priceNote.sh: "price not stated in the filing" when the filing states no price (the price and the value are then null, never 0; on a cluster, valueUsd is null); "≈ $61.36, midpoint of the stated range $60.86 to $61.85" when the price is the midpoint of…

pricePerShare.sh: Reported price per share in USD

quantity.sh: Shares failed to deliver, as the SEC publishes them

revenue.sh: Revenue for the same fiscal year, USD

revenueRange.sh: Issuer revenue range or fund net asset value range, as disclosed

securityClass.sh: Title of the class of securities

securityTypes.sh: equity, debt, options, pooled fund, other

shortVolume.sh: Shares sold short that day, as reported to FINRA's facilities

status.sh: reported (an 8-K with Item 2.02 on EDGAR) or estimated (an expected date, shown until the company's 8-K arrives)

totalAmountSold.sh: USD sold as of the filing

totalVolume.sh: Total shares reported to FINRA's facilities that day (not the consolidated tape)

trades.sh: Open-market purchase transactions in the window

txDate.sh: Transaction date from the filing, YYYY-MM-DD

units.sh: Bitcoin held as tagged in the filing; null when the filing gives no usable count

unitsOutstanding.sh: Shares or units of the class outstanding

unitsReliable.sh: true when the filing gives a usable coin count

unitsToSell.sh: Shares or units to be sold

updatedAt.sh: When the response was built; a few dated feeds give the date of their newest row instead

bitmexSymbol.sh: Always null, kept so existing clients parse unchanged

date.sh: The as-of date of the issuer file

exchange.sh: binance, bybit, okx, hyperliquid or kraken

flowUsd.sh: Net flow for the day in USD, derived from the change in the fund's reported holdings

fundingAnnualized.sh: Annualized rate, simple (not compounded), from the rate and its funding interval

fundingIntervalHours.sh: Hours per settlement: 8 (Binance, Bybit, OKX) or 1 (Hyperliquid, Kraken)

fundingRate.sh: Current funding rate as published, a decimal per settlement interval (0.0001 = 0.01% per interval)

fundingRate8h.sh: The rate scaled to eight hours, comparable across venues

holdings.sh: Coins held per the issuer file

longShortRatio.sh: Global long/short account ratio where the venue publishes it, else null

meta.sh: Who publishes the data and how to credit it

nextFundingTime.sh: ISO timestamp of the next funding settlement

rawSymbol.sh: Contract as the exchange names it

slug.sh: Symbol slug used in URLs (btc, eth, sol...)

updatedAt.sh: When the response was built; a few dated feeds give the date of their newest row instead

actual.sh: Filled after release from the agency series (CPI year over year %, payrolls monthly change in thousands, retail sales % m/m, claims in thousands, ...)

assetMgrLong.sh: Asset managers and institutional investors (tff); swap dealers (disagg)

assetMgrShort.sh: Asset managers and institutional investors (tff); swap dealers (disagg)

cusip.sh: Security CUSIP; a reopening shares the original's CUSIP

dealerLong.sh: Dealers and intermediaries (tff); producers, merchants, processors and users (disagg)

dealerShort.sh: Dealers and intermediaries (tff); producers, merchants, processors and users (disagg)

eventName.sh: CPI (Consumer Price Index), Nonfarm Payrolls (Employment Situation), Initial Jobless Claims, Retail Sales (Advance), FOMC Rate Decision, ...

forecast.sh: Always null: consensus forecasts aren't included

group.sh: currencies, indices, crypto, metals, energy, bonds, agriculture, other

highRate.sh: High discount rate (bills) or high discount margin (FRNs), percent

lastChanged.sh: Date of the most recent move

meta.sh: Who publishes the data and how to credit it

net.sh: assets minus tga minus rrp, USD

previous.sh: Prior period on the same basis as actual

reopening.sh: True when the auction adds to an existing issue

reserves.sh: Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks, USD (WRESBAL)

rrp.sh: Overnight reverse repo usage on that date, USD (RRPONTSYD)

securityType.sh: Bill, CMB (cash management bill), Note, Bond, TIPS or FRN

source.sh: bls, bea, census, fed, dol or treasury (coupon auctions)

unit.sh: What actual and previous are in: '% m/m', '% y/y, PCE price index', 'thousands, annual rate', 'USD billions, balance'

updatedAt.sh: When the response was built; a few dated feeds give the date of their newest row instead

y1_y30.sh: 1 to 30 year Treasury yields in percent

ratelimit.title: Rate limiting

retry.name: retry
retry.title: Retry

info.description: JSON and CSV over plain GET. Every response carries the same envelope: data, updatedAt, source, docs, license, attribution and meta, whose sourceAttribution line credits the publisher of the data. No key needed to start: 10 requests a minute per IP without a key and 30 a minute with a free account key, with at least six months of history. Data terms: https://xoomar.com/terms. Credit XOOMAR with a link to the dataset page when you republish the data.
info.summary: Free market data from primary sources: SEC, FINRA, CFTC, the Federal Reserve, Treasury, BLS/BEA/Census and the exchanges.
info.title: XOOMAR market data API
